tracesTo: SOW: Public League Support - For public leagues, allow non-logged visitors to view league content read-only
Gap Analysis: Priority 1 - Public league visitor stories (0% coverage)

stories.title: View Public League Content as Non-Authenticated Visitor
stories.goal: browse and view public league content without creating an account
stories.benefit: I can explore league information and decide if I want to join or create an account
acceptanceCriteria: Visitor can access public league pages via direct URL or league discovery without login
System displays league newsfeed with posts, comments, and reactions in read-only mode
Visitor can view power rankings with team standings and weekly rankings
Visitor can see matchup schedules and results for current and past weeks
Visitor can view transaction history and waiver wire activity
System displays league settings and roster rules in read-only format
All interactive elements (post, comment, like, trade) are disabled or hidden for visitors
System shows clear visual indicators that content is read-only (e.g., disabled buttons, lock icons)
Visitor can navigate between different league sections (newsfeed, rankings, matchups, transactions)
System prevents access to private league information and admin controls
Page performance is optimized for unauthenticated access with minimal data loading
System tracks anonymous visitor analytics for league discovery metrics

stories.title: Access League Team Rosters and Player Information as Visitor
stories.goal: view team rosters and player details in a public league
stories.benefit: I can understand team compositions and league competitiveness before joining
acceptanceCriteria: Visitor can view all team rosters in the public league
System displays starting lineups and bench players for each team
Visitor can see player names, positions, and current season statistics
System shows team records, points scored, and weekly performance history
Visitor can access individual team pages with detailed roster breakdown
System displays player injury status and bye week information
All roster management features (add, drop, trade) are hidden for visitors
Visitor can view historical lineup decisions and scoring breakdowns for past weeks
System provides tooltip or modal information for player stats without requiring login
Player comparison and analysis tools are visible but disabled with login prompt
System ensures roster data is cached appropriately for visitor performance
Visitor cannot see draft history or keeper designations without authentication

stories.title: View League Standings and Playoff Picture as Visitor
stories.goal: see current league standings and playoff implications
stories.benefit: I can follow league competition and understand playoff scenarios
acceptanceCriteria: Visitor can view league standings table with team names, records, and points
System displays division standings if league has multiple divisions
Visitor can see current playoff bracket or playoff qualification status
System shows clinched playoff spots and elimination status where applicable
Visitor can view historical standings from previous weeks
System displays tiebreaker information and playoff seeding rules
Standings are updated in real-time as games complete (within reasonable refresh interval)
Visitor can see points for and points against for each team
System provides sortable columns for different standing metrics (wins, points, streak)
Playoff projections and 'magic numbers' are visible if league uses them
System shows league median and average scoring statistics
All standings data is read-only with no ability to edit or challenge results

stories.title: Browse League Message Board and Announcements as Visitor
stories.goal: read league discussions and commissioner announcements
stories.benefit: I can gauge league activity and community engagement before joining
acceptanceCriteria: Visitor can view league message board with posts and replies in chronological order
System displays commissioner announcements and pinned posts prominently
Visitor can read post content, author names, and timestamps
System shows post engagement metrics (likes, replies, views) without interaction capability
Visitor cannot create new posts, reply to existing posts, or like content
System displays clear 'Login to Participate' message on disabled interaction elements
Message board is paginated or lazy-loaded for performance with large post history
Visitor can see post categories or tags if league uses them
System filters out deleted or moderated content appropriately
Visitor can view embedded media (images, links) within posts safely
System prevents access to private direct messages or admin-only announcements
Search functionality is available for visitors to find specific posts or topics

stories.title: Access League Rules and Scoring Settings as Visitor
stories.goal: review league rules, scoring format, and roster requirements
stories.benefit: I can determine if the league format matches my preferences before joining
acceptanceCriteria: Visitor can view complete league scoring settings (PPR, passing TDs, bonuses)
System displays roster composition requirements (QB, RB, WR, TE, FLEX, etc.)
Visitor can see league format (standard, keeper, dynasty, best ball)
System shows draft settings (snake, auction, date, keeper rules)
Visitor can view waiver wire rules and FAAB budget if applicable
System displays trade deadline, playoff schedule, and championship week
League constitution or custom rules document is accessible if published
Visitor can see lineup lock times and scoring period (weekly, daily, season-long)
System shows league size (number of teams) and playoff format (e.g., 6-team, 2-week matchups)
Visitor can view prize structure or buy-in information if league is public about it
All settings are display-only with no ability for visitors to propose changes
System provides comparison table if league uses custom scoring vs standard formats
